title: ADIP golden dataset record — support-ticket triage v1
description: One record per labeled support ticket. Labels follow the rubric in guidelines.md; this file is the machine-checkable contract. Frozen versions of the dataset live in datasets/ as golden-v<major>.<minor>.json.

ticket_id.description: Stable, anonymized ID; never derived from PII. Range TICKET-0001..TICKET-0050 for v1.

text.description: Redacted ticket body. MUST contain no real PII (see guidelines.md section 4); entities replaced with [PERSON] / [EMAIL] / [PHONE] / [ORDER] placeholders that keep sentence structure intact.

language.description: ISO 639-1 where known; v1 golden set is en-dominant. Used to eval Router behavior, not to filter.

source.description: Provenance. public-dataset-derived records must cite source_url in meta and must be paraphrased + redacted.

department.description: Exactly one. Ties broken by guidelines.md section 2.1; the tie-break reason goes in meta.notes.

urgency.description: Expected zero-based rubric level: 0=not urgent, 1=soon, 2=critical (guidelines.md section 2.2).

refund.description: True iff the customer asks for money back for this ticket (guidelines.md section 2.3). Store/exchange/credit requests are NOT refund=true.

labeler.description: Labeler identifier (initials or anon id) for QC reconciliation.

confident.description: False if the labeler hesitated; triggers second-labeler review in QC.

disagreement.description: True once two labelers disagreed and a reconciled label was fixed per guidelines.md section 5.

hard_case.description: True if the record exercises a known hard case from guidelines.md section 6; hard cases are mandatory in every version (>=8 per 50).
